description: This source file implements a JSON request handler thread for a host interface, including HTTP server initialization, JSON parsing with YAJL, and request handling using libsoup. It defines functions for starting/stopping the server, parsing JSON messages, and generating JSON responses.

methods.name: jsonIfHandlerThread
methods.description: Thread function that initializes and runs the HTTP server for JSON requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonParse
methods.description: Parses incoming JSON message using YAJL and returns a list of parameters.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, parses JSON, and sends JSON responses.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Initializes and starts the HTTP server to listen for JSON requests.
